Data Deletion

MiraiStack (registration number K2025971590). Effective 23 October 2026, last updated 23 October 2026.

  1. 1. Delete the data for one connected account
  2. 2. Delete your whole account
  3. 3. Remove KenganSocial from Facebook or Instagram
  4. 4. Remove KenganSocial from TikTok or Google
  5. 5. If you messaged or commented on a KenganSocial customer
  6. 6. Check a deletion request

1. Delete the data for one connected account

1. Sign in at https://kengansocial.co.za and open Connections. 2. Choose the account (Instagram, Facebook Page, Meta ad account, TikTok or YouTube) and select Disconnect. 3. We revoke our access with the platform where it allows this and delete the access token immediately. Messages, comments, profile details and analytics we stored from that account are deleted within 7 days.

2. Delete your whole account

1. Sign in and open Settings. 2. Select Delete account and confirm. 3. Your workspaces, uploaded content, schedules, automations, connected accounts and their data are deleted, and your sign-in is removed. Deletion completes within 30 days. Billing records are kept for 5 years because tax law requires it.

If you can no longer sign in, email privacy@kengansocial.co.za from the address on your account and we will delete it for you within 30 days.

3. Remove KenganSocial from Facebook or Instagram

— Facebook: Settings & privacy → Settings → Business integrations (https://www.facebook.com/settings?tab=business_tools) → select KenganSocial → Remove. — Instagram: Settings → Apps and websites (https://www.instagram.com/accounts/manage_access/) → select KenganSocial → Remove.

You can then choose to send a deletion request. Meta passes it to us automatically: we delete the data connected to your Facebook or Instagram account and Meta shows you a link to the status of your request, with a confirmation code. You can also check a code below.

4. Remove KenganSocial from TikTok or Google

— TikTok: Settings and privacy → Security → Manage app permissions → KenganSocial → Remove access. — Google / YouTube: https://myaccount.google.com/permissions → KenganSocial → Remove access.

When a platform tells us our access was removed, or refuses our access the next time we use it, we delete the token and that account's stored data within 7 days.

5. If you messaged or commented on a KenganSocial customer

Businesses use KenganSocial to manage the comments and messages people send to their accounts. If you contacted one of them, that business controls your messages; you can ask them directly to delete them.

You can also email privacy@kengansocial.co.za with the platform and your username. We will find and delete the copies stored in KenganSocial within 30 days and tell the business concerned.

6. Check a deletion request

Open https://kengansocial.co.za/data-deletion/status and enter the confirmation code you received, or follow the link Facebook or Instagram gave you.

Questions: privacy@kengansocial.co.za
